source_text: When operating or parking a disabled vehicle
scope: unselected synthetic propulsion-fault response; original Native disability, operating or parking act, facility designation and legal exception unverified
required_original_sources: original applied VehiclePhysicsControl before/after fault and get_physics_control readback
original 480-frame throttle, brake, ego pose, full-body and lane readback
original four-camera frames and synchronized frame/time map
observed physical propulsion response under a fixed command in faulted and healthy controls
separate act evidence to distinguish operating, stopping, standing and parking
synthetic_positive: 280 source-coded fault frames, 60 or 90 source-coded propulsion test frames, zero faulted displacement, positive healthy displacement and 140 full-body bicycle-lane occupancy frames in fixed window

fallback_triggers.fallback1: fault observation below 200 frames; synthetic 160 to 220 frames in faulted source
fallback_triggers.fallback2: propulsion test below 75 frames; synthetic 60 to 90 frames
fallback_triggers.fallback3: scripted reference visibility below 0.95; synthetic 0.887324 to 1.0
